blocks.text: Woodland Acres home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

5 houses sold in Woodland Acres with a median price of $1,295,000, taking a median of 8 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 20% sold above list. They had a median $587 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median lot of 7,345 square feet.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Woodland Acres?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 6 houses listed in Woodland Acres. Those are month-end counts and they move daily, so ask Jared for a current list.

faq.q: Is Woodland Acres a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 33% on only 6 listed, too few to read as a market type. The sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed; on the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers. One month in one community is a small sample, so look at the monthly table above before you decide.

faq.q: How many homes sold in Woodland Acres from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses and 0 condos and townhomes sold in Woodland Acres over those 5 months; detached houses peaked in October with 2 sold.

faq.q: How big is Woodland Acres compared with the rest of Port Coquitlam?
faq.a: In October 2026, Woodland Acres held 4.4% of the 137 detached houses listed in Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Are there more or fewer homes for sale in Woodland Acres than in June?
faq.a: Listings of detached houses fell from 13 in June to 6 in October 2026 (−53.8%).

faq.q: What did houses in Woodland Acres sell for?
faq.a: 5 houses sold in Woodland Acres between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,295,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Woodland Acres?
faq.a: The median was 8 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.0% of the last list price (20% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
